subject.title: fix(meetings): wait for audio bridge cleanup

question: Should maintainers accept the shared meeting-bot cleanup contract for Teams as well as Google Meet after confirming that the Teams stop path waits for the node-host settlement promise?
rationale: The patch deliberately broadens a Google Meet bug fix into the shared owner used by two meeting integrations, and the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit owner judgment on that cross-integration behavior.

options.title: Confirm shared consumer behavior
options.body: Verify the Teams caller awaits the shared node-host stop result and land the common cleanup implementation with its bounded shutdown latency.

options.title: Narrow to Google Meet
options.body: Keep the repair in the Google Meet owner if the Teams caller has a materially different stop or acknowledgement contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm shared consumer behavior
recommendation.body: Verify the Teams caller awaits the shared node-host stop result and land the common cleanup implementation with its bounded shutdown latency.

likelyOwner.reason: The replacement branch was authored around the shared owner boundary and is best positioned to explain the intended Google Meet and Teams contract.
